paragraphs: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chanina bar Papa bar Yitzchak.

He is cited by this full name near the end of “Vayikach Eliyahu” in Pesikta Rabbati (section 4 in the consulted text). Hyman gives the locator כג. and reports that הגרא״ז deletes the final “bar Yitzchak.”

notes.text: The locator כג. and the commentator’s initials הגרא״ז remain unresolved. Hyman’s deletion concerns the final “bar Yitzchak.”

The saved whole OYW Pesikta Rabbati4 scalar begins with Vayikach Eliyahu and, near its end in the Isaiah/Manasseh account, explicitly names Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chanina bar Papa bar Yitzchak. This supports the single section title and full chain. Hyman’s כג. pagination and הגרא״ז remain unresolved; deletion of the final bar Yitzchak is Hyman’s report, not a new genealogy repair or a proved deletion of bar alone.

Friedmann’s Vienna edition (1880, fol. 14a) gives the full chain in the text. In note לד, he reports a reading from Zera Ephraim that ends with Papa, and lists another variant separately. Israel’s National Library catalogue attributes Zera Ephraim to Ephraim Zalman Margolioth and records נוסחת הגרא״ז. The shorter reading is attested here through Friedmann. His folio 23a is a different section, so Hyman’s locator remains edition-specific. The original Zera Ephraim passage has yet to be collated.
